title: French Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting French-inspired stew made with lentils, smoky flavors, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the greek in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté the aromatic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the lentils and enough water to cover.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with the smoky and salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Check for seasoning and adjust as needed.
